Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion. Only human anatomy becomes smooth golden-yellow compact NEAR-ROUND mascot head/body, green-ringed black eyes, source-matching mouth. Preserve real source hair: BAREHEADED short DARK BROWN/BLACK neatly slicked-back/side-parted hair and real dark eyebrow HAIR. Preserve clean understated upper lip/chin, stern serious CLOSED mouth, no spectacles. Preserve DARK OLIVE CLOSED upright tunic collar with RED piping and actual small GOLD throat/front button, source-exposed RED/GOLD shoulder edge and only limited chest-decoration fragments visible beside note. No cap, tie, white shirt or invented hidden medal rows. Fine upper-lip shadow/engraving genuinely indistinct stays understated. Preserve exact primary frontal/mild angle/head roll, grey light/crop. A clearly ROUNDED SHORT U-SHAPED lower yellow head, never a long pointed V-shaped jaw, immediately meets raised/broadened existing neckline, VERY SHORT BROAD neck transition and minimal throat exposure. No separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping or cream belly bib. Preserve actual open/closed garment and fastening, coherent front/rear collar overlap/contact shadow. Retain complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual primary color and attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces opaque, alpha only outside complete card silhouette. No invented insignia/text/accessories. Fine primary details indistinct stay understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED short DARK BROWN/BLACK neatly slicked-back/side-parted hair and real dark eyebrow HAIR, clean understated upper lip/chin, stern serious CLOSED mouth, no spectacles. DARK OLIVE CLOSED upright tunic collar with RED piping and actual small GOLD throat/front button, source-exposed RED/GOLD shoulder edge and only limited chest-decoration fragments visible beside note. No cap, tie, white shirt or invented hidden medal rows. Fine upper-lip shadow/engraving genuinely indistinct stays understated. Preserve exact primary frontal/mild angle/head roll, grey light/crop.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
